lead: Ayub Khan was a politician, born on 14 May 1907 in Rehana.
He died on 19 April 1974 in Rawalpindi at the age of 66.

He has held the office of President of Pakistan and Federal Minister for Defence and has been recognised with Member of the Order of the British Empire and Knight Grand Cross of the Order of St Michael and St George.
Below you will find a verified overview of Ayub Khan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Ayub Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ayub Khan was born on 14 May 1907 in Rehana, and holds citizenship of British Raj and Pakistan.
His listed education includes Aligarh Muslim University, Royal Military College, Sandhurst, Command and Staff College and Minto Circle.
He is recorded as speaking Urdu.

sections.heading: Ayub Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, military personnel, financier and autobiographer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: President of Pakistan (1958–1969), Federal Minister for Defence (1958–1966), Commander in Chief (Pakistan Army) (1951–1958), Prime Minister of Pakistan (1958–1958), Federal Minister for Interior (1965–1965) and Federal Minister for Defence (1954–1955). He is affiliated with Pakistan Muslim League.
